metric: Nsight Systems kernel-active duration in microseconds
method: Actual precompiled Rust/CUTLASS CTM cubins, same common host harness and bit-exact fixture; serial rotating order, hot buffers, unlocked clocks, no graphs. CUDA-event and Nsight Compute replay timings are excluded.
variants_in_final_source: typed accumulator tile and static MMA/store expansion
two aligned u128 B-scale loads with constant u32 extraction
bounded u32 shared-offset arithmetic and factored half selector
experimental_only: Rust IR schema adapted for compiler 4.8
limits: One GPU and fixed workload; unlocked clocks.
Counter profiles use multiple replay passes and are diagnostic, not benchmark timing.
Savings from separate experiments are not additive; use within-experiment comparisons.
Source optimization remains slower than CUTLASS in the recorded run.
